title: Phagosome arrest and cytosolic access
dek: Mtb is not a happy resident of a sealed, acidic, fusion-competent phagolysosome. ESX-1, lipids, and CpnT-family toxins rewrite the compartment — and sometimes the cytosol.
story: A canonical phagosome acidifies, acquires Rab7 and LAMP, and fuses with lysosomes. Mtb delays that programme. Mannose-capped LAM, PDIM, and secreted effectors interfere with PI3P, Rab conversion, and v-ATPase assembly. The bacterium sits in a mildly acidic, fusion-poor niche that still communicates with the endocytic pathway.

ESX-1-dependent membrane damage — ESAT-6 is the named actor, the apparatus is the truth — lets bacterial products and sometimes bacilli access the cytosol. Cytosolic DNA then lights cGAS–STING; the host counter with ubiquitin, LC3, and xenophagy. The infection is a negotiation between damage and repair, not a static “intraphagosomal pathogen” cartoon from 1998.

CpnT (and its C-terminal TNT NAD glycohydrolase in some models) and other contact-dependent toxins add to macrophage death. Necrosis, not tidy apoptosis, feeds the caseum. Genomics labs meeting “latency” should remember: the compartment is heterogeneous inside one granuloma.
deepTitle: What this implies for drugs and screens
deep: pH of the niche is why PZA’s pH-dependent activity is a lesion story, not a broth story. Broth at pH 6.8 under-calls PZA.
Autophagy-modulating host-directed ideas (rapamycin-class, interferon programmes) sit on this map. They are research, not WHO regimens.
ESX-1 loss (BCG, some clinical attenuations) changes both the compartment and the IGRA antigen display.
Macrophage Tn-seq hits (espA, ecc genes, pdim loci) are the genetic proof that “phagosome arrest” is many genes, not a single switch named ESAT-6.

visual.caption: Uptake to a damaged, poorly fused compartment. Cytosolic leak is an ESX-1 branch, not a separate species of bacterium.

example.title: PZA “S” in pH 6.8 broth, R in acidified MGIT
example.setup: pncA wild type. One lab reports PZA-S in poorly acidified medium; WHO-method MGIT at acidic pH is R-borderline.

steps.title: PZA is a pH drug
steps.body: Pyrazinoic acid accumulation and activity require acidity. Neutral broth is the wrong object.

steps.title: The macrophage niche is closer to acid than to pH 6.8
steps.body: Phagosome arrest is not pH 7.4 cytosol. Phenotype methods have to respect that.

steps.title: Believe pncA plus a standardised pDST
steps.body: Do not invent a new resistance gene to explain a pH error.

example.takeaway: Compartment chemistry is part of DST.
